high.title: Fullstack Developer
high.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Full-stack Developer with hands-on experience building applications in the financial trading or capital markets domain. You will work across the full stack, designing and building responsive React frontends and high-performance Node.js backends while understanding the unique demands of trading platforms: real-time data streams, low-latency UI updates, order management workflows, and financial data integrity. This is not a generic web development role. You will be building systems where milliseconds matter, data accuracy is non-negotiable, and user trust is earned through reliability. If you've built trading dashboards, order books, portfolio trackers, or market data feeds, we want to talk to you. The core responsibilities for the job include the following: Frontend React: - Build and maintain high-performance, real-time trading UIs using React, TypeScript, and modern state management libraries (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or Recoil). - Implement live data visualization components like candlestick charts, order books, P& L dashboards, and position trackers using TradingView Lightweight Charts, Recharts, or D3.js . - Consume and render WebSocket streams for real-time price feeds, order status updates, and market depth without UI lag or memory leaks. - Design responsive, accessible interfaces optimized for both desktop trading workstations and mobile monitoring views. - Write unit and integration tests using Jest and React Testing Library; maintain high test coverage for critical trading flows. Backend Node.js - Design and develop RESTful and WebSocket APIs using Node.js (Express or Fastify) to serve trading data, order management, and user portfolio operations. - Integrate with exchange APIs, market data providers (Bloomberg, Refinitiv, or equivalent), and internal pricing engines handling rate limits, reconnection logic, and data normalization. - Implement order lifecycle management: placement, modification, cancellation, execution reporting, and reconciliation workflows. - Build data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and persisting tick data, OHLCV bars, and trade history at scale. - Ensure API security: JWT authentication, role-based access control, input validation, and audit logging for all trading operations. Architecture and Performance: - Optimize end-to-end latency across the full-stack profiling of React renders, Node.js event loop bottlenecks, and database query performance. - Implement caching strategies (Redis) for frequently accessed market data, user session state, and reference data. - Design for resilience: circuit breakers, graceful degradation, and fallback states for when market data feeds or exchange connections drop. - Participate in system design reviews and contribute to architectural decisions with clear documentation. Collaboration and Quality: - Work closely with quant analysts, trading desk stakeholders, and product managers to translate business requirements into precise technical specifications - Conduct and receive code reviews with a focus on correctness, performance, and maintainability, especially for financial calculation logic - Support QA with test scenario design for edge cases: market open/close, circuit breakers, partial fills, and rejection handling - Participate in on-call rotations and respond to production incidents with urgency during market hours Requirements: - 3-5 years of full-stack development experience with React and Node.js in production environments. - Demonstrable experience building or maintaining applications in financial trading, capital markets, fintech, or investment management. - Strong TypeScript proficiency across both frontend and backend codebases. - Solid understanding of WebSocket protocols and real-time data handling: you've built something that updates live without polling. - Experience with REST API design and integration with third-party financial data or exchange APIs. - Familiarity with financial domain concepts: order types, order book mechanics, P& L calculation, position management, and trade lifecycle. - Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL and MongoDB or Redis). - Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud deployment (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Preferred Qualifications: - Experience integrating with FIX protocol, broker APIs (Interactive Brokers, Alpaca, and Zerodha Kite), or exchange connectivity layers. - Familiarity with the TradingView Charting Library or Lightweight Charts for professional-grade market data visualizations. - Knowledge of message queues and event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ) for high-throughput trade event processing. - Exposure to algorithmic trading systems, backtesting frameworks, or quantitative finance tooling. - Understanding of regulatory requirements: MiFID II, SEBI guidelines, or exchange compliance rules. - Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog). Technical Skills Snapshot - Frontend: React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit / Zustand, WebSockets, D3.js / Recharts. - Backend: Node.js, Express/Fastify, REST APIs, WebSocket Server, JWT Auth. - Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis (caching and pub/sub). - Trading Domain: Order Management, Market Data Feeds, FIX Protocol, Exchange APIs. - DevOps and Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS / GCP, GitHub Actions / Jenkins. - Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Postman / Newman, k6 (load testing). - Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, ELK Stack. Key Competencies: - Precision under pressure: financial systems demand correctness above all; you never cut corners on data integrity. - Real-time systems thinking: you understand event loops, memory management, and rendering pipelines at 50 updates per second. - Domain fluency: you speak the language of trading desks, not just engineering standups. - Ownership: When the market opens, your system needs to work; you take that personally. - Collaborative rigor: honest, specific code review feedback given and received. - Continuous learning: financial markets evolve, regulations change, and new asset classes emerge; you stay current. Company Summary At Zzazz, we're building the first Large Pricing Model (LPM), a revolutionary system that quantifies the real-time value and price of digital content, transforming it into a new class of dynamic asset. Unlike LLMs, which generate content based on input, our system generates real-time value and price based on multiple factors, including user decision-making behavior, market dynamics, quality, timing, contextual impact, and other critical attributes. Our advanced Economic AI learns, adapts, and evolves the perceived worth of each piece of content, assigning it a dynamic market value. We're shaping a global economy where every piece of content impacts and matters. Zzazz is building the foundation for the future of the information economy. We believe that digital content deserves more than arbitrary monetization models and opaque metrics. By assigning transparent, real-time value to the world's data and insights, we empower everyone, from the casual user who sees the price and understands its worth to creators, consumers, advertisers, and businesses, to engage in a more equitable and meaningful exchange. Our mission centers on trust, innovation, and inclusivity. We bring together a diverse team of thinkers, builders, and problem-solvers passionate about shaping a fairer digital marketplace, one that respects the complexity and worth of information and the people who produce it. Why Join Us You're not just looking for a job; you want to make an impact. You thrive in environments that challenge the status quo, you believe in bold ideas, and you want to be at the forefront of technological innovation. If you're ready to take on big challenges and shape the future of digital content with AI, then Zzazz is where you belong. At Zzazz, we move fast and push boundaries. We work hard, and we're here to get things done. Our benefits are designed to fuel your drive and ambition, giving you the support and resources needed to perform at your best!

high.title: AI Engineer — Innovation Lab
high.description:
About the Role


The Innovation Lab applies and adapts AI to accelerate work across eGov’s spectrum of products and platform — DIGIT and the products built on it, including DIGIT HCM (Health Campaign Management). The Lab runs a continuous pipeline of experiments, taking validated problems through bounded prototypes to capabilities that eGov’s product teams can adopt. It applies foundation models and modern GenAI techniques to gov tech problems rather than building models from scratch.
The AI Engineer is a hands-on builder in the Lab. Working closely with the AI Tech Lead, the engineer turns experiment ideas into working prototypes, runs evaluations, and helps build the reusable components and harnesses that keep the Lab fast — following sound engineering discipline throughout. This is an early-career role for a fast learner who is fluent with modern AI tools and eager to grow, with depth built through pairing, code review and bounded experiments across applied AI, engineering craft and the gov tech domain.


Key Responsibilities


• Build prototypes: Turn experiment briefs into working prototypes under the direction of the AI Tech Lead — using foundation models, LLM APIs, prompting, RAG and related techniques.
• Evaluation and evidence: Help design and run evaluations of prototypes for quality, reliability and latency, and capture results, limitations and observations clearly.
• Engineering quality and SDLC: Follow a disciplined development lifecycle — version control, code review, automated testing and continuous integration — writing clean, tested, documented and reproducible code.
• Reusable components: Contribute to shared components, evaluation harnesses and starter repositories that raise the Lab’s throughput.
• Handover-readiness: Produce clear technical notes and documentation so prototypes are transferable rather than black boxes.
• Communicate and collaborate: Pair with the Tech Lead and partner engineers, present at sprint showcases, and communicate progress, results and blockers clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.


Required Skills & Experience


1. Foundations: 0–2 years of experience; freshers welcome. Strong computer-science fundamentals — data structures, algorithms and clean coding practice. A degree in computer science or engineering, or equivalent demonstrable ability.
2. Applied AI (core): Hands-on experience building with LLMs and modern AI tools — through work, internships, academic, hackathon or personal projects. Familiarity with prompting, LLM APIs and at least one AI/GenAI framework. Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as part of everyday building.
3. Programming: Strong in at least one language, with Python preferred for AI work. Exposure to web or full-stack development; willingness to work across the DIGIT stack (Java, React, Flutter) is an advantage.
4. SDLC and engineering craft: Good grasp of the software development lifecycle — Git and collaborative development, code review, automated testing (unit and integration) and CI/CD basics — with care for documentation and reproducibility.
5. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain what was built and why, and to collaborate effectively within a small team.
6. Disposition: Fast learner; curious, resourceful, and able to work with minimal supervision. Interest in public sector, development sector, global health or govtech is a plus.


Good to have
• Experience with RAG, vector stores or agentic patterns; evaluation of AI systems; cloud (AWS/Azure) and Docker; contributions to open-source projects.


Position: AI Engineer — Innovation Lab
Position Type: Full Time
Location: Bangalore
Reports to: AI Tech Lead — Innovation Lab
Department: AI & Innovation Lab
Experience: 0–2 years (freshers welcome)


About eGov Foundation & DIGIT
eGovernments (eGov) Foundation, is a pioneering tech-for-good organization that exists to drive exponential impact in public service delivery at speed & scale. We are on a mission to enhance the ease of living for citizens by improving access to essential public services. Our work involves:
• Driving digital transformation globally: with our open-source platform, DIGIT (Digital Infrastructure for Governance, Impact, and Transformation), to empower nations on their journey towards modernized public services.
• Providing strategic guidance: to countries on harnessing digital public goods (DPGs) for the effective transformation of their digital services and governance.
• Fostering dynamic networks: that accelerate the adoption of digital solutions, facilitating exponential progress and innovation within governments and communities.
Our platform, DIGIT, has already benefited over 160 million citizens and continues to expand its reach, touching the lives of over 2.5 billion people worldwide. Practice areas we work in include local governance, public health, public finance, water, sanitation and climate. Our work spans across 10 countries globally and 2,600 towns and cities across 16 states in India.
If you’re passionate about revolutionizing public service delivery and enhancing the lives of billions, we’d love for you to join our team. Whether you are in a hands-on role or supporting from behind the scenes, your contributions are vital and impactful. Join us in making a transformative difference!


Why work with us?
• Make a Large Scale Impact: Contribute to projects with the potential to drive significant societal change. Gain experience tackling diverse challenges on both national and global stages.
• Learn from the Best: Receive mentorship from leading experts and professionals within our rich ecosystem, broadening your perspectives and expertise.
• Harness Technology for Good: Be part of a team dedicated to using technology to address real-world problems and enhance the lives of citizens.
• Grow and Lead: Develop essential skills and seize remarkable opportunities to lead initiatives that shape your career, all within an environment of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.


Read more about the work of eGov Foundation:

2. https://egov.org.in/digit/

high.title: Full Stack Engineer
high.description:
About the Role
At Healthify, we're building technology that helps millions manage their health through scalable consumer applications, backend systems, and AI-powered products.
We're looking for a strong Full Stack Engineer with hands-on expertise in React, TypeScript, Python, and system design. You'll own features end-to-end—from translating Figma designs into polished user experiences to building scalable backend services and optimizing production systems.


What You'll Do

- Frontend: Build responsive, production-ready applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and Next.js. Work on frontend architecture, state management, rendering, and performance optimization.
- Backend: Design and develop APIs, services, and background jobs using Python, Django, or FastAPI.
- Databases & System Design: Work with SQL and NoSQL databases, caching, indexing, concurrency, and distributed systems.
- Performance & Scalability: Identify bottlenecks and improve application reliability, latency, and infrastructure efficiency.
- AI Engineering: Integrate LLMs, AI agents, and intelligent workflows while leveraging AI-assisted development tools effectively.
- End-to-End Ownership: Drive features independently from design and implementation through deployment and production support.


What We're Looking For
Must Have

- Strong hands-on experience across both frontend and backend development.
- Proficiency in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and modern frontend architecture.
- Production experience with Python and Django or FastAPI.
- Strong understanding of APIs, databases, HTTP, networking, caching, and system design.
- Experience building, deploying, and scaling applications used by thousands of users or more.
- Ability to translate Figma designs into polished product experiences.
- Strong problem-solving skills, engineering fundamentals, and independent ownership.
Good to Have

- Experience building products from scratch and working with complex codebases.
- Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, LangChain, or LiteLLM.
- Knowledge of Redis, message queues, asynchronous processing, Docker, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure.
- Experience optimizing performance, scalability, and infrastructure costs.


Why Join Healthify?

- Build products used by millions of people.
- Own features across frontend, backend, and architecture.
- Solve challenging scalability and AI engineering problems.
- Work with modern technologies and influence technical decisions.

medium.title: SDE I Backend Engineer
medium.description:
Backend Engineer (SDE 1)


About Astra


Astra is a cybersecurity SaaS company that makes otherwise chaotic pentests a breeze with its one-of-a-kind Pentest Platform. Astra's continuous vulnerability scanner emulates hacker behavior to scan applications for 9,300+ security tests. CTOs & CISOs love Astra because it helps them fix vulnerabilities in record time and move from DevOps to DevSecOps with Astra's CI/CD integrations.
Astra is loved by 650+ companies across the globe. In 2023, Astra uncovered 2 million+ vulnerabilities for its customers, saving customers $69M+ in potential losses due to security vulnerabilities.
We've been awarded by the President of France, Mr. François Hollande, at the La French Tech program and the Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, at the Global Conference on Cyber Security. Loom, MamaEarth, Muthoot Finance, Canara Robeco, ScripBox, etc. are a few of Astra's customers.
Role Overview
At Astra Security, we are building the future of AI-driven cybersecurity, including Autonomous Pentesting — an experience that helps teams automatically discover, test, and secure Web & Mobile applications, Cloud, and APIs at scale.


As a Backend Engineer (SDE 1), you will work on building and improving the backend systems that power Astra's cybersecurity platform. You'll develop APIs, backend services, database components, and asynchronous workflows that support our core product.
You'll work closely with experienced backend engineers, frontend engineers, product managers, DevOps, and QA to build reliable and scalable features. You'll get hands-on experience taking features from development to production, debugging real-world issues, and learning how distributed backend systems are designed and operated at scale.
This is an opportunity to work on challenging engineering problems, contribute to 0-1 product initiatives, and grow your backend engineering skills in a fast-paced product environment.


Here's what's in it for you

- Build and maintain backend services and RESTful APIs for Astra's platform.
- Develop clean, maintainable, and reusable code following sound software engineering principles.
- Work with databases to design tables, write queries, and improve application performance.
- Build and work with asynchronous workflows using queues, events, and background processing.
- Debug production and development issues and identify the root cause of problems.
- Write unit and integration tests to ensure reliability and code quality.
- Work with AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity while reviewing and validating generated code before it reaches production.
- Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to continuously improve your engineering practices.

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

About Company

Fractal is a leading AI and analytics company that helps global enterprises turn data into decisions at scale. We are looking for a hands-on Senior Full Stack Engineer with 6+ years of experience to design, build, and scale enterprise-grade digital products across front-end, back-end, APIs, cloud, DevOps, and AI-enabled application layers. This role requires strong engineering ownership, practical design thinking, and the ability to deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing solutions in collaboration with architects, TPMs, and cross-functional teams.

Role Brief

You will own critical feature implementation across web applications, APIs, integrations, cloud-native services, and AI-powered capabilities. The role combines deep hands-on engineering with practical participation in technical design, code quality, performance optimization, and operational excellence.

You will work closely with architects, TPMs, product managers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, designers, and peer developers to translate solution intent into scalable, maintainable, and production-ready systems.

Key Responsibilities Include



- Develop robust, efficient, and maintainable code for critical features, ensuring both functional and non-functional requirements are met.
- Participate in system and solution design discussions, contributing practical implementation insights, technical trade-offs, and pseudo-code where needed.
- Act as a technical point of contact for day-to-day implementation issues, troubleshoot challenges quickly, and drive timely resolution.
- Enforce and improve code quality through code reviews, engineering standards, automated testing, and secure development practices.
- Collaborate closely with architects, TPMs, product teams, and platform teams to translate high-level designs and AI use cases into scalable, secure, and production-ready solutions.
- Build and integrate AI-powered application capabilities such as copilots, intelligent assistants, summarization, search, recommendations, and workflow augmentation using LLM APIs and related services where relevant.
- Implement AI-enabled solution patterns including prompt orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding strategies, structured outputs, tool or function calling, and quality or safety guardrails for enterprise use cases.
- Support and improve DevOps practices including build pipelines, CI/CD workflows, automated testing, release readiness, and engineering observability.
- Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application, system, and AI feature performance in line with project objectives, reliability expectations, latency targets, and cost considerations.
- Document technical designs, implementation decisions, and operational considerations to support maintainability, auditability, and knowledge transfer.
- Mentor junior engineers by sharing best practices, reviewing work products, and guiding them on sound engineering approaches.
- Contribute to technical proposals, estimations, reusable assets, and implementation improvements including automation, refactoring, and component reuse.
- Maintain compliance with security, quality, governance, and audit expectations, and contribute to broader process and capability improvement initiatives within CDT.


Must Have



- 6+ years of hands-on experience building enterprise-grade full-stack applications, with strong ownership of complex engineering workstreams from design through delivery.
- Strong expertise in one or more modern front-end frameworks such as React, along with solid command of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Strong back-end engineering experience in at least one major stack such as Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask), Node.js (Express, NestJS, or similar).
- Strong understanding of system design fundamentals, design patterns, API design, scalability, reliability, performance optimization, and distributed application architecture.
- Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or similar, including schema design and query performance tuning.
- Hands-on experience building and consuming REST APIs and working with modern integration patterns across services and external systems.
- Strong understanding of responsive web design, reusable component-based architecture, accessibility basics, and front-end performance optimization.
- Hands-on experience with automated testing practices including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing using tools such as Jest, PyTest, Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent.
- Working experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including deployment, configuration, observability, and support for cloud-native environments.
- Hands-on experience with containerization and modern engineering environments using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent platforms.
- Strong understanding of DevOps and secure SDLC practices including CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, code reviews, build automation, and release quality controls.
- Hands-on experience integrating AI capabilities into applications, including LLM APIs, prompt design, structured outputs, tool or function calling, and building reliable user-facing AI features.
- Good understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, grounding strategies, prompt orchestration, and common GenAI failure modes such as hallucination and response inconsistency.
- Experience implementing evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails for AI-enabled features, including response quality checks, fallback handling, latency and cost awareness, and privacy or security considerations for enterprise use cases.
- Ability to translate solution architecture into detailed implementation plans and contribute effectively to technical design discussions with architects and engineering leads.
- Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to rapidly resolve production and implementation issues while maintaining engineering quality.
- Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to engineering best practices, reusable assets, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Excellent problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and client-facing delivery environments.


Nice to Have



- Experience working in Agile delivery environments with close collaboration across product, QA, DevOps, TPM, and architecture teams.
- Exposure to performance tuning, observability, logging, monitoring, caching, and reliability engineering practices in production systems.
- Experience contributing to reusable frameworks, shared components, internal accelerators, or broader engineering capability-building initiatives.
- Prior experience supporting estimations, technical proposals, solutioning discussions, or client-facing technical workshops.
- Exposure to AI engineering frameworks and tooling such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, vector databases, model gateways, or similar ecosystems for building production-grade GenAI applications.
- Experience with LLMOps or MLOps practices such as prompt versioning, evaluation pipelines, experiment tracking, workflow observability, and responsible AI controls.
- Exposure to building AI copilots, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or domain-specific GenAI solutions for enterprise products.


What Success Looks Like In This Role



- Own critical full-stack feature implementation and deliver high-quality solutions with minimal oversight.
- Convert architecture intent into scalable, secure, and production-ready implementations across core and AI-enabled application capabilities.
- Uphold strong engineering standards across code quality, testing, security, documentation, performance, and DevOps practices.
- Act as a dependable technical anchor by resolving implementation issues quickly and collaborating effectively across functions.
- Drive continuous improvement through reuse, automation, maintainability, mentoring, and contribution to team capability building.
- Deliver reliable AI-enabled experiences with appropriate quality, safety, observability, and cost awareness.


If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!
